title: Asymptotic Bounds for Irredundant Covers of Square Grids by 2 x 2 Cards
summary: We study an irredundant covering of an $m \times m$ square grid by $2 \times 2$ cards, where cards may overlap and every card must lie entirely inside the grid. Every square of the grid must be covered, and every card must contain at least one square that is covered only by itself. Let \(F(m)\) denote the maximum number of cards in such an irredundant cover. We develop a general framework for bounding the maximum possible size of such an irredundant cover based on square multiplicities, double counting, and local geometric restrictions arising around highly covered squares.
